detail.interpretation: Real total forcing (all anthropogenic + natural components) modestly improves the fit over CO2-only forcing -- a genuine, real-data-grounded answer to the CO2-only-vs-full-forcing question, not a dramatic difference: the CO2-only approximation was already reasonably close.
